Under the assumption of rational expectations, ytþ1 will be uncorrelated with information available at time t. In this case, (10.16) forms a regression equation that can be estimated consistently by leastsquares. Unfortunately, estimates of such equations usually reject the joint hypothesis that a 1⁄4 0 and b 1⁄4 1, generally obtaining point estimates of b significantly less than 1. Some of this empirical evidence is summarized in Rudebusch (1995, table 1) and McCallum (1994b, table 1).
